verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents creating custom frameworks or custom controls with user-defined tests and evidence requirements. The nearest items are adjacent features: Custom Integrations that push resource data into Secureframe's existing testing, custom policies, custom fields for Personnel and Tasks, and an MCP server that can 'manage' controls, tests and frameworks without saying custom ones can be created. None of these deliver the story itself.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
